title: Financial Management Software and Support Services (RFI)
description: Request for Information only, for market research, issued by the First Responder Network Authority (FirstNet Authority). The government is seeking responses from entities able to provide financial management software and support services, and will use responses to decide the acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. Amendment 002 extended the response date to October 26, 2026. Amendment 001 clarified the number of users for market research pricing. The contemplated NAICS code is 541519 Other Computer Related Services; Information Technology Value Added Resellers.
